BeatScope measures a song; Beathi turns those measurements into a film. Everything
runs on your machine.

## What this release is

**The timing-only handoff package (contract `beatscope-package-1`, version 0.12.0).**
A `.beatscope` zip carries the measured facts — beats, transients with band
energies, tempo segments, bars, cues, structure families and boundaries, plus an
ordering value for spending a limited response budget — together with the
deterministic runtime they are queried through, a self-check probe, agent routing
instructions, a Skill, MIDI and CSV sidecars, and a per-member SHA-256 manifest.
It ships **no visual layer and no task statement**, on purpose: the visual is the
consumer's decision, and a package that pre-decides it stops the agent from asking
what the user wants. Source audio is never included.

**Beathi Studio is the only page.** Open the local server, drop in a song, and the
studio measures it, cuts a deterministic film from those measurements and plays it
back. The retired surfaces — the legacy player page, the canvas workspace, the
composition workbench and the compiled visual recipe/timeline layer — are gone
along with their web demo and Pages workflow.

**WebMCP Studio Director (in-browser).** In a WebMCP-capable browser the studio
registers seven tools over `document.modelContext`, so an agent can read the
current state, query a bounded window of measured timing, ask for a bounded set of
original response-worthy onsets, explain why the film cuts where it does, drive
playback and audition, start a seeded render and prepare the timing package — while
every page-changing call is visible in the studio and can be undone where that
makes sense. Ordinary browsers are unaffected: nothing is registered and nothing
is shown.

## Verified in CI for this release

- Contracts, queries, actions and registration suites, plus a Playwright round trip
  that registers the tools against the real local server, reads timing back and
  **renders an actual film**.
- The packaged Windows build is smoke-tested end to end before publishing: launch
  the app, serve the studio, confirm the bundled movie toolchain is detected,
  analyse a synthetic take, render it, and read the MP4 back.
- Python: 719 passed / 4 skipped. JavaScript: 93 passed. Frontend typecheck and
  build: green.

## Honesty notes

- `response_relevance` is an **ordering value**, never a probability or a
  confidence, and the response tools spend a caller-sized budget over existing
  onsets without moving, merging or inventing timestamps.
- Structure appears as repeat families (`A`, `B`, `A′`) — never as "verse" or
  "chorus" — and no instrument identity (kick, snare, 808) is inferred.
- Analysis and rendering stay on your machine. There is no hosted service behind
  this release, and no audio is uploaded anywhere.
